instruction: What is the title of the most-liked song in my Spotify playlists.

take_first_edit.description: Select one song for a singular highest/lowest request, or keep the requested top/bottom K from the front of the current ranking.
take_first_edit.skill: Sorting orders the songs but does not select a winner. When the request asks for the title of the song with the highest or lowest attribute, select one song here before extracting titles or submitting. Use the requested K for a bounded list, and skip this step if the user wants the whole ranking.
